# Local Lead Generation Agent

The Apify actor [`apify/local-lead-generation-agent`](https://apify.com/apify/local-lead-generation-agent) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.23**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Find truly local leads by scraping Instagram profiles based on search queries. Extract website links, contact details, emails, social media details. The AI agent matches and scores leads using LLMs via LangChain, explains scoring, and compiles the data into a common dataset for easy access and use.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Lead Analysis $0.03 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/local-lead-generation-agent) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-local-lead-generation-agent@0.0.23#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      queries: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queries` | string | yes |  | Search term — Use regular search words like fitness, barber or flower shop. |
| `location` | string | yes |  | Location — Use country (e.g. Spain, Iceland) or exact location (e.g. Barcelona, Vienna). |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Number of leads — Set the number of local leads you want to scrape. The actual output may be slightly lower due to duplicates in Google Search results. |
| `searchLanguage` | string |  | `""` | Search language — Restricts search results to pages in a specific language. For example, choosing 'German' results in pages only in German. Passed to Google Search as the lr URL query parameter. Read more here (https://developers.google.com/custom-search/v1/reference/rest/v1/cse/list). |
| `scoreLeads` | boolean |  | `true` | Use LLM to score leads — Whether to use an LLM to score the leads, if this is the disabled the following options will not be used |
| `llmPrompt` | string |  | `"Score by engagement rate."` | Score the leads — Write the prompt to score the leads by. |
| `yourBusinessDetails` | string |  |  | Your business details — Tell the LLM a few words about your business so it can figure out your angle. |

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |

| `username` | string \| null | Instagram username of the lead |
| `fullName` | string \| null | Full display name of the lead's profile |
| `biography` | string \| null | Profile bio text |

| `score` | number \| null | Lead score assigned by the LLM based on the scoring prompt |

| `pinterests` | array \| null | Pinterest links found for the lead |
